name: Scramble

faq.answer: Scramble is a scavenged trail quest guiding an adventurer to a hidden survival cache. A written note directs anyone who finds it to march north down a treacherous cliff to recover buried supplies.

According to the instructions, the cache is buried approximately one hundred paces due north, situated down a steep cliffside. It requires careful footing to reach without tumbling down the rock face.
faq.q: Where is the hidden stash located?

faq.answer: The exact identity of the author remains unstated. The writer left informal, practical notes intended for an explorer to locate their emergency provisions, confirming the stash remained intact.
faq.q: Who left the note and the cache?

faq.answer: Unearthing the cache reveals a buried messenger bag containing survival supplies and a dirty parchment tucked among the gear.
faq.q: What is inside the buried stash?

faq.answer: The dirty parchment is stuffed inside the buried messenger bag alongside the provisions, discovered when the bag is pulled from the ground.
faq.q: What is the dirty parchment found with the supplies?

faq.answer: The primary hazard is navigating the steep descent down the cliffside to the north, where a misstep can lead to broken ankles or serious falls.
faq.q: What hazards are involved in reaching the cache?

sections.body: A cryptic message directs any traveler clever enough to find it toward a hidden supply cache. The writer leaves informal encouragement alongside precise directions: march one hundred paces due north down a treacherous cliffside to uncover provisions left behind to keep a traveler going.
sections.title: The Northward Trail

sections.body: Following the instructions down the steep cliff face reveals a buried messenger bag. Dug out of the dirt, the bag contains practical survival supplies alongside another dirty parchment tucked inside, suggesting this brief scramble is part of a larger trail.
sections.title: Unearthing the Messenger Bag

summary: Scramble is a hidden treasure hunt that directs adventurers to follow coordinates down a steep cliffside. Guided by a scavenger's note, travelers unearth a buried messenger bag containing survival provisions and a dirty parchment.
